description: This file contains utility functions for comparing images, buffers, and text, including image resizing and validation, used within the Playwright project for visual testing and diffing.

classes.name: ImageData
classes.description: Type representing image data with width, height, and pixel buffer.

methods.name: compareBuffersOrStrings
methods.description: Compares two buffers or strings and returns a result indicating differences.

methods.name: compareImages
methods.description: Compares two images (PNG or JPEG) with options for size and pixel difference thresholds.

methods.name: validateBuffer
methods.description: Validates that a buffer is a valid PNG or JPEG image based on magic numbers.

methods.name: compareText
methods.description: Compares two text strings and produces a diff with colored output.

methods.name: resizeImage
methods.description: Resizes an image data object to specified dimensions, padding with transparent pixels if needed.
